page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual server deployed on a KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at 2.25 GHz, delivering 4 vCPUs. It is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU. The configuration contains no dedicated hardware acceleration or graphics processors.

Storage and networking specifications highlight a diskless architecture that relies exclusively on external block storage services, as zero local storage is bundled with the instance. For interconnectivity, the platform delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in the base package.

The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC compute resources and proportional memory capacity delivers stable operational behavior for environments requiring uniform resource distribution. The server is well matched for mid-tier web serving, application backends, containerized microservices, build nodes, and general enterprise workloads operating with external persistent storage volumes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance based on the x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated AMD EPYC 9T95 vCPUs operating at 2.25 GHz alongside 16.0 GB of memory, delivering a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM allocation with 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local storage devices, requiring attached cloud disks for system and persistent storage. Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. Designed for predictable throughput without fractional or burstable CPU throttling, ecs.g9ae.xlarge provides balanced capacity suited for web serving, microservices architectures, application middleware, and routine enterprise business workloads.
